jobs.title: Senior Product Manager I, Expert Apply
jobs.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Product Manager I, Expert Apply based in United States.

This role offers the opportunity to lead the product strategy for an AI-powered job search automation experience designed to help people navigate the job market more efficiently.

You will own the end-to-end product roadmap, balancing customer needs, business growth, experimentation, and long-term product vision.

A major focus will be developing a mobile-first experience that improves the application funnel, adoption, engagement, and retention.

You will work closely with Engineering, Design, Marketing, Analytics, and other teams in a highly collaborative and globally distributed environment.

The role combines rigorous experimentation, quantitative analysis, qualitative research, and competitive intelligence to guide product decisions.

You will have significant autonomy to identify opportunities, prioritize initiatives, and turn insights into measurable product improvements.

This is an ideal opportunity for an experienced consumer product leader passionate about AI, growth, and building practical tools that create meaningful outcomes for users.

Accountabilities

Develop and execute a high-impact product roadmap, aligning product priorities with customer needs and broader business objectives.
Own the end-to-end product strategy for the Expert Apply experience, driving continuous improvements and growth initiatives.
Partner closely with Engineering, Design, Marketing, Analytics, and leadership to define requirements, prioritize initiatives, and deliver product outcomes.
Champion a mobile-first product strategy focused on optimizing the application funnel, increasing adoption and retention, and supporting the launch of a dedicated mobile application.
Design, execute, and interpret rigorous A/B tests across product experiences and marketing channels to identify opportunities for growth.
Collaborate with Email Marketing and other teams to develop retention strategies, including leveraging job alerts and other engagement mechanisms.
Use market trends, competitive analysis, quantitative metrics, and qualitative user research to identify customer needs and translate insights into actionable product features.
Continuously evaluate product performance and use data-driven insights to refine priorities, improve user experiences, and support revenue growth.
Manage multiple concurrent initiatives and competing priorities while maintaining strong attention to detail and execution quality.
Communicate product strategy, priorities, results, and trade-offs clearly to cross-functional stakeholders.

Requirements

6–10 years of experience in consumer-facing Product Management.
Proven experience owning product strategy and roadmaps for consumer digital products.
Strong expertise in A/B testing, experimentation methodologies, quantitative analysis, and interpreting complex datasets to drive business decisions.
Demonstrated ability to translate customer insights, market trends, competitive intelligence, and product data into actionable product strategies.
Strong understanding of modern technology stacks and the ability to assess technical complexity and effort while partnering effectively with engineering teams.
Exceptional organizational and prioritization skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects and competing priorities simultaneously.
Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with experience leading initiatives across multidisciplinary teams.
Ability to work effectively and autonomously in a globally distributed, remote environment.
Experience with B2C subscription products, job boards, or AI-driven products is preferred.
Passion for AI-powered consumer experiences, experimentation, continuous improvement, and data-driven product development.

Benefits

Competitive salary with location-based ranges of $150,000–$175,000 for most eligible locations.
Salary range of $165,000–$195,000 for San Francisco, New York, and Seattle locations.
Salary range of $155,000–$185,000 for Austin and Chicago locations.
Bi-annual bonus opportunity.
Equity participation.
401(k) plan with company match.
Flexible spending accounts for healthcare and dependent care.
Internet and home office reimbursement.
Medical, dental, and vision coverage, with optional family plans.
Life and long-term disability insurance options.
Mental health support and wellness resources.
Wellness reimbursement for eligible activities and services.
Optional pet insurance.
Flexible paid time off, sick time, and observed holidays.
100% remote, work-from-home position.
Eligible hiring across specified U.S. states and Puerto Rico.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager - Edifecs
jobs.description:
Overview

The Senior Product Manager – Edifecs
is the liaison between business stakeholders, product management leadership and engineering managers. This role works with these stakeholders to understand current and future needs related to one or more products and/or modules and iteratively develop product features to evolve products based on product roadmap. Senior Product Manager – Edifecs is well versed with working in agile / scrum framework, software development lifecycle and uses this expertise to bridge gap between customer facing product management and engineering / development functions.

Responsibilities

Own the product development lifecycle end-to-end: discovery, requirements, roadmap planning, feature definition, release execution, and post-launch maintenance for a pre-defined product area.
Lead product initiatives focused on healthcare enrollment, including ingestion, validation, transformation, error handling, reconciliation, and downstream system integrations.
Requirements Gathering: Working closely with stakeholders to gather and document product requirements, ensuring that the product meets the needs of both internal and external users.
Translate business and regulatory needs into clear product requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and product specifications.
Sprint / Project Management: Overseeing the entire product development lifecycle, from ideation to launch and beyond. This includes defining sprint / project timelines, managing resources, and coordinating efforts across different teams to ensure timely delivery of high-quality products & incremental improvements.
Create and maintain product documentation for features, release notes, conceptual data flows, and product interfaces.
Incorporate a strong design mindset, working closely with UX/UI partners to define intuitive workflows, simplify complex enrollment processes, and ensure solutions are user-centered and easily accessible.
Partner with engineering teams to prioritize backlog, clarify requirements, and maintain product quality across releases.
Collaborate with QA and engineering to ensure robust test coverage and overall product quality.
Complete all responsibilities as outlined in the annual performance review and/or goal setting.
Complete all special projects and other duties as assigned.
Must be able to perform duties with or without reasonable accommodation.

This job description is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed and is not to be construed as an exhaustive list of responsibilities, duties and skills required. This job description does not constitute an employment agreement and is subject to change as the needs of Cotiviti and requirements of the job change.

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree with strong academic performance in Health Sciences, Computer Science, Engineering, Economics, Mathematics, or other quantitative field.
5-8+ years of product management experience.
Strong understanding of healthcare member enrollment processes, including eligibility, enrollment maintenance, reconciliation, and benefits administration for different Lines of Business.
Prior experience working in a product development lifecycle (Agile preferred), including backlog management, roadmap planning, and feature delivery.
Ability to translate technical concepts and complex enrollment workflows into clear business requirements.
Good communication, stakeholder management, interpersonal and cross-functional collaboration skills, including working with offshore team members.
Ability to engage with technical teams (e.g. engineering, client, implementation) to discuss data models, workflows, and system behavior in case of critical production bugs.

Preferred / Nice-to-Have Qualifications

Prior experience as Software Engineer.
Prior experience with Edifecs tools or platforms (EAM, SpecBuilder , TM, ENR, XEServer , XEngine ).
Understanding of related EDI transactions (e.g., 834, 999, TA1).
Exposure to member enrollment processes for Group and Medicaid LOBs.
Familiarity with cloud-based architectures and modern integration patterns.

Cognitive/Mental Requirements

Great written and oral communication skills.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
High ownership and ability to work independently.
Ability to influence without authority.
Comfortable operating in fast-paced, evolving environments.

Working Conditions And Physical Requirements

Remaining in a stationary position, often standing or sitting for prolonged periods.
Must be able to provide high-speed internet access/connectivity and office setup and maintenance.
Repeating motions that may include the wrists, hands, and/or fingers.
Must be able to provide a dedicated, secure work area.
No adverse environmental conditions are expected.

Base compensation ranges from $115,000 to $140,000 per year. Specific offers are determined by various factors, such as experience, education, skills, certifications, and other business needs.

Cotiviti offers team members a competitive benefits package to address a wide range of personal and family needs, including medical, dental, vision, disability, and life insurance coverage, 401(k) savings plans, paid family leave, 9 paid holidays per year, and 17-27 days of Paid Time Off (PTO) per year, depending on specific level and length of service with Cotiviti. For information about our benefits package, please refer to our Careers page.

Since this job will be based remotely, all interviews will be conducted virtually.

Date of posting: 7/2/2026

Applications are assessed on a rolling basis. We anticipate that the application window will close on 10/2/2026, but the application window may change depending on the volume of applications received or close immediately if a qualified candidate is selected.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Product Manager based in the United States.

This role sits on an expansion-focused product team responsible for bringing AI-powered solutions into new workflow areas. You’ll own product decisions from customer discovery through launch, defining which workflows to tackle and how the product should solve them at scale. You’ll spend meaningful time observing healthcare professionals and operational teams to understand how work is performed manually and where processes break down. Your insights will shape products that deliver immediate value while creating the foundation for greater automation over time. Working closely with engineers, designers, product operations, forward-deployed teams, and implementation specialists, you’ll balance customer needs with scalable product strategy. This is an opportunity to build products in a fast-moving environment where thoughtful discovery, strong judgment, and hands-on execution directly influence outcomes.

Accountabilities

Own a portfolio of workflows end to end, from discovery and prioritization through launch and the resulting outcomes for customers.
Conduct customer discovery, workflow observation, and shadowing sessions to understand operational processes, pain points, and opportunities for improvement.
Translate customer insights and operational challenges into clear product opportunities and make informed recommendations about what should be built.
Determine which capabilities should become scalable product features and which should remain customized for individual customers, working closely with product engineering and forward-deployed teams.
Establish product priorities and roadmaps based on customer feedback, data, business impact, and the potential for future automation.
Design solutions that deliver value today while accounting for the evolving role of humans and AI in operational workflows.
Collaborate with engineers and designers to define product requirements, capabilities, and user experiences.
Write clear product briefs, specifications, acceptance criteria, and decision memos that enable teams to move forward efficiently.
Own product rollouts from planning through execution, including identifying, managing, and resolving issues that arise during implementation.
Partner closely with implementation and customer-facing teams to incorporate real-world feedback into product improvements.
Use data, customer feedback, and product performance insights to continuously refine workflows and product capabilities.
Build products that can serve an expanding customer base while maintaining a strong understanding of the operational context in which they are used.

Requirements

4+ years of product management experience with ownership of product roadmaps and priorities.
At least 2 years of experience building software for a specific industry, such as healthcare, legal, logistics, construction, or a similar vertical market.
Demonstrated experience replacing a manual process with software by deeply understanding how people perform the work and translating those insights into a shipped product.
Experience using data, customer feedback, and qualitative insights to guide product improvements and prioritization.
Strong stakeholder management skills, including the ability to push back on customer requests thoughtfully while maintaining trust and strong relationships.
Ability to recognize when a technical approach may not adequately address customer needs and collaborate with technical teams to identify practical alternatives.
Strong written communication skills, with the ability to create clear briefs, specifications, memos, and requirements that minimize unnecessary meetings.
Strong product judgment and the ability to balance immediate customer value with long-term scalability.
Preferred experience in prior authorization, revenue cycle management, or specialty healthcare workflows.
Experience working in an early-stage startup environment is a plus.
Background in design or engineering is a plus.
Experience building and launching products powered by language models or other AI technologies is a plus.

Benefits

$160,000–$205,000 annual compensation.
Equity opportunity.
Fully remote work environment.
Opportunity to build AI-powered products addressing complex operational challenges in healthcare.
Direct impact on healthcare organizations, operational efficiency, and patient care.
Exposure to customer discovery, product strategy, AI automation, and new product development.
Collaborative work with engineering, design, product operations, implementation, and customer-facing teams.
Opportunity to contribute to products that evolve from hands-on customer workflows into scalable solutions.
Career growth within an early-stage, mission-driven environment.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, WFI
jobs.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Product Manager, WFI based in the United States.

As Senior Product Manager, Workforce Intelligence, you will lead an emerging enterprise product from early market validation into a durable, scalable business. You will own the product strategy, roadmap, and commercial outcomes, with success measured through adoption, retention, and revenue. Working closely with engineering and design, you will turn complex customer problems into clear hypotheses, experiments, and product decisions. You will engage directly with senior engineering leaders to understand how organizations measure AI productivity, spend, risk, and value. The role combines product discovery, technical fluency, data-driven experimentation, and cross-functional leadership across sales, marketing, customer success, finance, and product. You will also help define new approaches to AI attribution, benchmarking, reporting, and agent governance in a rapidly evolving category.

Accountabilities

Own the Workforce Intelligence product strategy and roadmap, connecting priorities to activation, adoption, retention, and revenue outcomes.
Conduct continuous discovery with CTOs, VPs of Engineering, engineering managers, and design partners to understand how enterprises evaluate AI tools, productivity, spend, and risk.
Translate uncertain customer problems into testable hypotheses, rapidly prototype solutions, run experiments using real customer data, and discontinue initiatives that do not demonstrate sufficient value.
Lead the evolution of trusted AI attribution and reporting, connecting activity and cost at the work-item level to executive insights around throughput, delivery timelines, capacity, and savings.
Develop the product vision for agent oversight, including identifying agent-only work, connecting it to funded initiatives, explaining associated costs, and providing appropriate context for reviewing results.
Shape benchmarking approaches for AI tools and models using customers' own teams and workflows, with transparent methodologies and clearly communicated confidence levels.
Define connector and data strategies spanning AI providers, developer environments, source control, work management, collaboration tools, and related products.
Collaborate with product leaders across timesheets, capacity planning, financial management, and other product areas to create connected customer value while maintaining clear ownership and sequencing.
Partner with sales, marketing, and customer success on positioning, pricing, packaging, launches, enablement, adoption, and expansion.
Establish instrumentation, product metrics, and operating rhythms that support evidence-based decisions and visible trade-offs across customer value, technical feasibility, trust, and commercial impact.
Represent Workforce Intelligence with customers, partners, platform stakeholders, and senior leaders, communicating a clear product perspective and building alignment across competing priorities.
Work directly with engineering and design from problem definition through delivery in a small, dedicated team with high ownership and minimal handoffs.
Use AI collaboratively in day-to-day product work to improve communication, experimentation, and delivery efficiency.

Requirements

5+ years of product management experience, including end-to-end ownership of a B2B SaaS or data product serving technical audiences.
Demonstrated success improving adoption, retention, expansion, or revenue, with the ability to clearly explain the decisions, metrics, and outcomes behind your work.
Experience taking a product or significant product area from discovery through launch and growth while partnering closely with engineering, design, and go-to-market teams.
Strong product judgment in ambiguous or emerging markets, with the ability to distinguish interesting capabilities from meaningful customer problems and build clear investment cases.
Deep customer discovery experience across interviews, usage data, prototypes, and live product experiments.
Experience designing experiments capable of disproving product hypotheses rather than simply validating existing assumptions.
Comfort working with imperfect, incomplete, or inferred data, clearly communicating confidence levels and limitations.
A track record of changing product direction when customer evidence contradicts the original plan.
Experience with developer tools, engineering intelligence, data and analytics products, AI governance, or another technically complex enterprise product.
Working knowledge of software delivery workflows, including Jira work items, source control, pull requests, engineering performance measures, and the role of AI tools and agents in modern development.
Strong data fluency and the ability to collaborate with engineering and analytics teams on attribution models, instrumentation, benchmarks, and reporting methodologies.
Experience with the Atlassian ecosystem or another platform and marketplace business is an advantage.
Hands-on experience with modern AI tools and a thoughtful perspective on where AI can generate measurable value versus unreliable or misleading outputs.
Understanding of AI product considerations including model evaluation, agent behavior, privacy, governance, cost, and rapidly evolving vendor capabilities.
Ability to establish trustworthy measures of human and AI-assisted work and clearly distinguish supported conclusions from areas of uncertainty.
Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to explain complex technical and commercial concepts without relying on unnecessary jargon.
Demonstrated ability to align engineering, design, sales, marketing, customer success, finance, and executive stakeholders around shared outcomes without relying on direct authority.
Credibility with senior technical buyers and a strong curiosity about how they make product, technology, and investment decisions.
Low attachment to individual ideas and a strong commitment to evidence, outcomes, and continuous learning.

Benefits

Remote-first work environment.
Unlimited vacation in most locations.
Health, dental, and vision coverage, along with a savings plan.
Training reimbursement and work-from-home reimbursement.
Professional development opportunities, including conferences, courses, and mentorship.
Diverse and dynamic teams working on challenging and meaningful projects.
Opportunities to make a direct impact on the business and enterprise productivity.
Social activities, including virtual and in-person events.
Optional in-person meetups and opportunities to travel to international offices.
Employee referral program.
Applications should be submitted with a resume in English.
Equal opportunity workplace committed to an inclusive culture and consideration of qualified applicants without regard to protected characteristics.

to ensure your application is reviewed quickly, objectively, and fairly against the role's core requirements. The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team.
